choices.english: it has become audible to you
choices.why: Perfect middle indicative of γίνομαι with dative of person; standard expression for 'it has come to your hearing'

choices.term: σκληρὸς εἶ, καὶ νεῦρον σιδηροῦν ὁ τράχηλός σου
choices.english: you are hard, and your neck is an iron sinew
choices.why: Metaphorical construct: νῦρον stands metaphorically for rigidity; σιδηροῦν modifies νῦρον as compound adjective; literal 'sinew of iron' conveys unbending stiffness

choices.term: Ἰσοπαλῆ γὰρ ἔχει τὴν γαλήνην τῇ οἰκείᾳ δόξῃ
choices.english: For it holds its gentleness equal to its own glory
choices.why: Ἰσοπαλῆ as adverb meaning 'equally, in balance'; dative τῇ οἰκείᾳ δόξῃ indicates standard of comparison; 'equal to its own glory' captures the reciprocal relationship
rejected: it has calmness equal to glory

choices.term: ὥσπερ ἀμέτροις ὑπεροχαῖς τὸ τῶν γενητῶν ὑπερνήχεται μέτρον
choices.english: And just as the measure of the things that are born exceeds excess
choices.why: ἀμέτροις ὑπεροχαῖς dative plural of measureless excess; ὑπερνήχεται is present middle indicative of ὑπερνυχόμαι; the clause sets up a cosmic comparison before the divine attribute
rejected: as the measure of born things exceeds measureless excess
like the born things' measure goes beyond excess
